Our Story

A quiet place to actually rest

Happy Staycation in Azure started in 2023 with one unit we rented out ourselves — no team, no call center, just the two of us learning as we went. What guests kept telling us, though, wasn't about the discounts or the view. It was that they finally slept well. That they felt like they could breathe for a few days. In a city that rarely slows down, that's the whole idea behind the name.

A full renovation later, we've brought on a small team to help with cleaning, restocking, and answering messages quickly — but every booking still passes through us personally. Whether you're settling in after a flight, resting between meetings, or celebrating something quiet with someone you love, Maui 511 and Positano 1903 are built around the same promise: a space that's actually yours for the days you're here.

Cook a real meal in a fully equipped kitchenette, spend an afternoon at Azure's wave pool and manmade beach just steps from your door, or simply close the blinds and do nothing at all. However you rest, we want it to feel effortless.

Who It's For

Made for however you're traveling

Different trips need different things — but they tend to come down to the same one: somewhere quiet to land at the end of the day. Here's how guests actually use the units.

Family time that isn't rushed

Multi-generational trips, reunions, and long weekends together — with real bedrooms and a kitchen for shared meals, everyone gets room to actually be together instead of stacked in a hotel room.

Work trips that still let you sleep

In town for a trade show, a conference, or back-to-back meetings? Our units are quiet enough to actually recharge between commitments — a real bed and a door that closes, not a shared hallway.

Slow weekends, just the two of you

No lobby to walk through, no crowd to compete with — just a private space to celebrate an anniversary, a proposal, or simply a weekend that's yours alone.

The barkada trip you keep postponing

Karaoke, billiards, and card games are already in the unit, so the night doesn't have to end when the restaurant closes. Positano 1903 sleeps up to six — and if there are more of you, message us and we'll help arrange it.

Early flights and late landings

Most of our airport guests land at night, so there's no cut-off on arrivals — come in whenever your flight gets in, no arranging needed. A short drive from NAIA, check-out at 12:00 NN, and a real night's sleep either side of the flight.

Longer stays and working weeks

400 Mbps wifi, a kitchen you can properly cook in, and rates that drop the longer you stay — 10–15% off from three nights, up to 20% by the month. For project assignments, remote-work stretches, or the gap between one place and the next.

Beyond the Unit

Everything else at Azure

Your unit comes fully set up on its own — here's what else is around, in case you want to venture out.

Azure Beach Club & Wave Pool

The wave pool, manmade white-sand beach, and kiddie pool aren't included in your room rate — they're run separately by the property for ₱250 per entry (free for kids under 3ft). Open in two shifts: 7:00 AM–12:00 NN and 2:00 PM–7:00 PM.

Steps Outside Azure

SM Bicutan is right beside the property, with 7-Eleven, Lawson, and Alfamart inside Azure itself for quick errands. La Shish Mediterranean Restaurant is close by too, for the nights you'd rather not cook.

Booking

How booking works

No accounts, no platform, no waiting on a form. Four steps, all of them through us.

1

Message us

Send your dates, which unit, and how many of you there are — on Facebook or by text. We'll confirm availability and the rate for those nights.

2

Reserve with ₱1,000

A reservation fee holds your dates and becomes your security deposit. Payable by GCash — we'll send the account details once your dates are confirmed.

3

Fill in the guest form

Names and ages of everyone staying, plus vehicle details if you're bringing a car. We send it over as soon as the reservation is in.

4

Pay the balance at check-in

The rest is settled on the day you arrive, by GCash or bank transfer. Nothing is charged before then.

Your ₱1,000 comes back after your stay

It's held as your security deposit. Once our cleaner confirms the unit is in good order — nothing damaged, missing, or heavily stained — it goes straight back by GCash, usually within 2–3 hours of check-out. If something did get damaged, we'll message you, agree on a fair amount for it, and return the balance; those cases normally settle within 24 hours. It isn't refunded if you cancel.

Confirmed bookings are final

We can't cancel, reschedule, or refund once a booking is confirmed, so please double-check your dates before you reserve. Weather is the one exception — if a storm makes your trip genuinely unsafe, message us and we'll work something out. For anything else, ask us before you book rather than after; we'd rather help you pick the right nights.

Bring valid IDs

A government ID for everyone 18 and over, and a school ID for ages 13–17. Nothing needed for under 13. The tower concierge checks these to issue your visitor passes, so don't leave them at home.

Parking is ₱400

In the tower basement. Send us the plate number, model, and colour along with the guest form and we'll arrange it.

Leave it as you found it

Wash up, drop the trash on your way out, and take everything with you. A ₱500 charge comes off the deposit only if the unit is left excessively dirty or the linens are heavily stained.

We'll send your check-in guide

A QR code for the main gate plus step-by-step directions to your tower. The route differs a little between Maui and Positano, and on weekends, so we send the right one for your stay.

Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

What time is check-in and check-out?
2:00 PM check-in and 12:00 PM check-out, for both Maui 511 and Positano 1903.
I land late at night — can I still check in?
Yes, and you don't need to arrange it beforehand. There's no cut-off on arrival time, so come in whenever your flight gets in. Check-in is yours from 2:00 PM onward, and check-out is 12:00 NN.
How do I book?
Message us on Facebook with your dates and number of guests. We'll confirm availability and walk you through the rest — no account or app needed.
Do you offer a discount for longer stays?
Yes, and it deepens the longer you stay. Three nights or more gets you 10–15% off at either unit, and month-long stays go up to 20%. Message us with your dates and we'll quote you.
What if there are more than 6 of us?
We coordinate with other trusted hosts in the same building so your group can stay close together instead of splitting up across different properties. Message us on Facebook with your group size and dates and we'll help arrange it.
Is beach and pool access included?
Not in the room rate — the wave pool, manmade beach, and kiddie pool are run separately by the property for ₱250 per entry (free for kids under 3ft), open 7:00 AM–12:00 NN and 2:00 PM–7:00 PM daily.
